title: I'm Leaving My Cottage - I was not ready for this
en: so it looks like i'm moving out earlier than i anticipated initially i was expecting not have to do this until late may or early june but things changed it's an interesting reminder that you can plan and anticipate and prepare for the future and still not be able to predict what will happen plans change and sometimes an opportunity will arise even if you don't feel 100 ready for it it can be hard to know the right course of action in the moment but i find that with time and some courage answers eventually come it's up to us to listen and understand ourselves while it will take me at least a month

or so to transition to a new location i've started the process by next week i should have all my things moved out if you're going through a change right now be that a physical location or a more personal transformation know that you are not alone and change even if it is hard can lead to such beautiful things do it really hasn't hit home yet that i am

leaving i think it will take another week or so to really start feeling those emotions i haven't yet started going through my more personal items objects filled with memories and letters from people i once knew but i know that it will be a very cathartic and interesting experience to go through things that you've kept hidden away and examine them once again reevaluating what things mean to you maybe this video can inspire you to also welcome the spring and a beautiful new season by going through what you own and considering what you value what you should keep in your life and maybe what you should let go so
so i filled this up without even thinking about the fact that it would be too

heavy to move so um yeah so i guess um plan b i clearly don't know what i'm doing you think after moving like 17 times in my life um i'd know how to pack everything up really well but i don't i don't oh my here we go again do

so i was going through some of my old things and i found this box and i'm pretty sure i made this box when i was a teenager and it is spray painted and it says uh neverland on it it is the entire map of neverland i'm sure it's very geographically accurate and it has some quotes on the side it even has glitter and tinkerbell on it and yes i just thought it was too funny and of course inside what is there but some dead leaves dead flowers random pieces of journal paper a picture of a fairy

um pine cones some covered with glitter and acorn cups and i remember getting these acorn cups because i remember thinking they look like little teeny tiny cups for fairies and that um it was obviously something i needed in my life so i'm questioning my past decisions now i don't know what i'll do with all these little things but yeah it's funny to go through it and look into the past and just remember little things about you what's wrong buddy

what do you want what do you want yeah chaos so um everything feels so chaotic right now i have books everywhere so i'm definitely still in the process of kind of getting all that organized but um yeah it's been a interesting week it's it's been a lot of emotions yes by the time you have seen this i will hopefully be completely moved out it is interesting to me because for many years in my life when i was not as healthy

physically and mentally i definitely felt that any decision that made me uncomfortable or self-conscious in any way was a decision i should avoid making or i should just always stick to what's in my comfort zone and what makes me feel the best and what doesn't challenge me and i think that's a time of life that we all find ourselves in in some shape or form this move is the very first decision that i have made that has not been out of necessity it has been 100 my own decision and my own wish to start a new life and to start a new phase of life in a new home it has been such a wonderful experience

to move everything out it's been very cathartic i have found a lot of items from my past especially some letters from years ago and certain mementos that i was able to remember those memories um really see them in new light and understand that it was time to put those items aside and put them away and most of the letters are made of paper so i did end up composting a lot of those items and finding natural ways to dispose of them so there have been certain experiences i've had in my life in which i have forgotten what happened during certain portions of time i can't recall them

there's kind of a blank space in my brain that doesn't allow me to access certain memories and it's been interesting through the process of going through a lot of these items having some of those memories return and it's been very very interesting and very cathartic and yeah it's it's been good and also bittersweet and it's uh it's always fascinating what a fascinating experience to move your things perhaps this can be inspiration to all of you to consider the springtime as a new beginning we are almost in spring we are so close and i think it always can be a good experience to go through the things you own

and remember their meaning see if their meaning has changed maybe some of these things that you thought were very very important to you you feel differently about now i'm sending so much love and i will see you very very soon goodbye you
zh: 所以看起来我比我最初预期的要早搬出去，我原以为要到五月底或六月初才能这样做，但事情发生了变化，这是一个有趣的提醒，你可以计划、预测和为未来做好准备，但仍然无法预测会发生什么计划改变，有时机会会出现，即使你没有做好100准备，目前很难知道正确的行动方针，但我发现随着时间的推移和一些勇敢的答案最终会出现，这取决于我们倾听和理解我们自己，而这至少需要我一个月的时间
大约要过渡到一个新的地点，我已经在下周开始这个过程，如果你现在正在经历一个改变，无论是物理位置还是更个人的转变，我应该把我所有的东西搬出去，知道你并不孤单，即使很难，改变也可以带来如此美好的事情，它真的还没有击中要害吗？
离开我想还需要一周左右的时间才能真正开始感受到这些情感我还没有开始翻阅我更个人的物品，那些物品充满了我曾经认识的人的记忆和信件，但我知道，翻阅你一直隐藏的东西并再次审视它们对你意味着什么，这将是一次非常宣泄和有趣的经历，重新评估它们对你意味着什么，也许这个视频可以激励你也欢迎春天和美丽的新季节，通过回顾你拥有的东西，考虑你珍视的东西，你应该在生活中保留什么，也许你什么应该如此放手

所以我正在翻阅我的一些旧东西，我发现了这个盒子，我很确定这个盒子是我十几岁的时候做的，它是喷漆的，上面写着呃梦幻岛，这是梦幻岛的整个地图，我确信它在地理上非常准确，它的侧面有一些引言，上面甚至有闪光和小叮当，是的，我只是觉得它太有趣了，当然里面有什么，但有一些枯叶，死花，随机的日记纸，一张仙女的照片
嗯，一些松果上覆盖着闪光和橡子杯子，我记得买了这些橡子杯子，因为我记得它们看起来像仙女的小杯子，嗯，这显然是我生活中需要的东西，所以我现在质疑我过去的决定，我不知道我会用所有这些小东西做什么，但是是的，回顾它并回顾过去，只记住关于你的小事，怎么了，伙计，这很有趣
你想要什么 你想要什么 是的，混乱，所以嗯，现在一切都感觉很混乱，我到处都有书，所以我肯定还在整理一切的过程中，但是嗯，是的，这是有趣的一周，有很多情绪，是的，当你看到这个的时候，我希望能完全搬出去，这对我来说很有趣，因为在我生命中的很多年里，当我不那么健康时
在身体和精神上，我绝对觉得任何让我不舒服或以任何方式感到不自在的决定都是我应该避免做出的决定，或者我应该始终坚持我的舒适区中的事情以及让我感觉最好的事情以及不会挑战我的事情，我认为这是生命中的一个时期，我们都发现自己处于某种形状或形式，这一举动是我做出的第一个决定，这并不是出于必要，这是我自己的决定和我自己开始新生活并开始的100个决定在新家开始新的生活阶段真是一次美妙的经历
把所有东西都搬出来，这是非常宣泄的，我发现了很多我过去的物品，特别是几年前的一些信件和某些纪念品，我能够记住这些记忆，嗯，真的以新的眼光看待它们，并明白是时候把这些物品放在一边并把它们收起来了，而且大多数信件都是纸做的，所以我最终确实堆肥了很多这些物品，并找到了自然的方法来处理它们，所以我在生活中经历了某些经历，其中我忘记了在某些时期发生的事情。有些时候我记不起它们
我的大脑中有一片空白，不允许我访问某些记忆，在经历很多这些项目的过程中，让其中一些记忆回归，这很有趣，这非常非常有趣，非常宣泄，是的，它很好，也苦乐参半，呃，移动你的东西总是令人着迷，这是一种多么迷人的体验，也许这可以激励你们所有人将春天视为一个新的开始，我们快到了春天了，我们快到了如此接近，我认为浏览你拥有的东西总是一个很好的经历
记住它们的含义，看看它们的含义是否改变了，也许其中一些你认为对你来说非常非常重要的事情，你现在感觉不同了，我送出了如此多的爱，我很快就会见到你，再见
